# PDFree

> Free, privacy-first PDF toolkit. Every tool runs entirely inside the browser using WebAssembly and a Web Worker — files are never uploaded to a server, there is no account, no daily limit, and no subscription. Verifiable by inspecting the Network tab during use: no file-content requests leave the device.

PDFree offers merge, split, compress, rotate, watermark, redact, protect/unlock, flatten, organize, resize, add page numbers, edit metadata, extract pages, draw/annotate, fill & sign forms, OCR, scan documents with a camera, compare two PDFs, split manga page spreads, prepare PDFs for e-readers, check PDF/A archival compliance, look up PDF terminology, read PDFs in a distraction-free reflow reading mode, and convert between PDF and JPG/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Markdown — all client-side. Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Russian, Japanese, Italian, Korean, Dutch, Polish, and Turkish.

## Key pages

- [Merge PDF](https://pdfree.io/merge-pdf/): combine multiple PDFs into one, locally in the browser.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfree.io/split-pdf/): split a PDF into separate files or page ranges.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfree.io/compress-pdf/): reduce PDF file size without uploading.
- [OCR PDF](https://pdfree.io/ocr-pdf/): extract searchable text from scanned PDFs locally.
- [Check PDF/A Compliance](https://pdfree.io/pdf-to-pdfa/): check and convert a PDF to PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-2u for long-term archiving.
- [Redact PDF](https://pdfree.io/redact-pdf/): permanently remove sensitive content, not just visually cover it.
- [Document Scanner](https://pdfree.io/scan-document/): turn camera or gallery photos into a cropped, cleaned-up PDF.
- [Document Glossary](https://pdfree.io/glossary-pdf/): clickable definitions for PDF and document terminology.
- [PDF Tools with No Upload](https://pdfree.io/pdf-tools-no-upload/): explanation of the local-processing architecture.
- [HIPAA-Considerations PDF Tools](https://pdfree.io/hipaa-pdf-tools/): why local processing matters for regulated documents.
- [Secure PDF Tools](https://pdfree.io/secure-pdf-tools/): overview of the site's privacy/security model.

## Comparisons

- [iLovePDF Alternative](https://pdfree.io/ilovepdf-alternative/): no upload, no daily limits, direct feature-by-feature comparison.
- [Smallpdf Alternative](https://pdfree.io/smallpdf-alternative/): free, no upload, no daily limit — direct comparison.
- [Adobe Acrobat Alternative](https://pdfree.io/adobe-acrobat-alternative/): fill, sign, edit PDF without a subscription.
- [PDF24 Alternative](https://pdfree.io/pdf24-alternative/): browser-based, no upload, no install.

## Notes

- No API. No account system. No server-side storage of any kind.
- Source of truth for tool list and locales: https://pdfree.io/sitemap.xml
